name: Gumberoo
description: The Gumberoo is a fearsome critter of Pacific Northwest lumberjack folklore — a hairless bear-shaped creature with a hide so tough that bullets bounce off, but which explodes when set on fire.

aliases.name: Megalogaster repercussus
aliases.meaning: fanciful Latin classification given by William T. Cox (1910)

origin: Confined in folklore to the Pacific Northwest of North America — the heavy-timber districts of Oregon, Washington, northern California, and coastal British Columbia.
